name: Timoshenko beam
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 同时考虑弯曲和剪切等效应的梁模型。
usage_overview: 铁木辛柯梁常用于建立钢轨、齿轨的柔性模型，在动力分析中计入剪切变形和转动惯性，以描述其受载响应；也用于弹性轮对建模，并与实体柔性轮对模型比较。

complete_examples.text: A simple dynamic model for monobloc concrete sleepers with non-uniform cross-sections had been derived using Timoshenko beam theory.

Besides Aggestam et al. [11] used an extended state-space vector approach to solve the vehicle-track interaction, where the Rayleigh-Timoshenko beam theory is implemented into the modeling of the rail and concrete layers.

For the establishment of a 3-D slab track system, the finite elements considering the bending and possible shearing of the slabs such as the Mindlin-Ressiner plate elements and the rail such as the Timoshenko beam, are introduced.

The wheelset subsystem is modelled as a rigid–flexible body including the flexible Timoshenko beam with variable cross sections, characteriz-ing the wheelset vertical vibration, and the rigid body, char-acterizing the wheelset lateral vibration.
Page 21 of 22 the high-frequency dynamic response of the wheelset, and the variable-section Timoshenko beam wheelset is also suitable in calculating responses of vehicle–track coupled dynamic model.
The track structure comprises the rail, track slab and base plate, with the rail is modeled by the Timoshenko beam, while the track slab and base plate are represented by double beam elements.

As presented in Fig. 1, based on the work in Ref. [27], the train-track-tunnel-soil dynamic interaction is outlined as follows: • Rail: simulated as Timoshenko beam; • Track slab: modeled as Mindlin plates; • Basement: simulated using iso-parametric hexahedral elements; • Connected components: including the fasteners, filling layer, pri mary and secondary suspension of the train, are modeled as spring-damping elements; • Tunnel: simulated as iso-parametric hexahedral elements; • Soil around the tunnel: simulated as iso-parametric triangular prism element; • Far-field soil: simulated as hexahedral elements.
The track structure is composed of two sub-structures: rail and track slab, which are simulated by Timoshenko beam and Mindlin plate respectively.

In order to verify the practicality of the model proposed in this paper, the calculation results of rigid wheelsets, Timoshenko beam elastic wheelsets (Xu, 2023) (hereinafter referred to as elastic wheelsets) and the flexible wheelsets model proposed in this paper will be compared in this section based on the vehicle-track dynamic interaction model.
